estimate.item: Agent test servers never touch real settings: any serve.py that a scrum agent (builder or reviewer) starts to render the dashboard must run on a fresh free port (never 8765) with HOME and CLAUDE_HOME pointed at a throwaway temp dir, enforced in the agent prompts/SKILL.md and checked before Save/Undo clicks. The real dashboard on 8765 keeps full permission to edit the real ~/.claude, with no new confirms. Came from job 044, where a UX reviewer reached a stale serve.py on port 8791 and replaced ~/.claude/rules/performance.md with 'new rule 1440'.
estimate.why: Needs HOME/CLAUDE_HOME isolation in the builder and UI/UX reviewer prompts and SKILL.md plus a serve.py guard and contract tests; agents only pick a spare port today.
